purpose: Rank existing Commons offers by the shortest honest path from present buyer pain to a paid, accepted delivery without deleting or deprioritizing longer-horizon offers.

truth.payment_note: USD 1 of cash is independently evidenced by the Frantic bounty #120 provider receipt recorded in revenue/right_now/settled_cash.json and the merged Sourcey PR #1423; bank availability and withdrawability remain unasserted. The Agent Failure Autopsy ($29) product was retired on 2026-09-17; no live public checkout remains. All right-now routes stay scope-first with buyer-specific payment handoff. The $2,500 same-day survival proof stays on revenue/production_survival/README.md.

ranking_rule: buyer can state the job now using public or synthetic inputs
deliverable already exists as a proven Commons capability
lowest founder and buyer coordination burden
price is copied from the canonical source

portfolio.NOW: A buyer can start the qualification path immediately and Commons can deliver the bounded outcome in seven days or less.
portfolio.SOON: One buyer conversation, private input, legal document, or customer-specific invoice is needed before delivery.
portfolio.LATER: Recurring software, infrastructure, licensing, grants, enterprise pilots, and other compounding lanes remain active in commerce.html.

offers.name: Agent Failure Diagnostic
offers.buyer_input: One non-confidential sentence plus an optional locally generated triage packet.
offers.deliverable: A known / unknown / not-tested diagnosis, one stop / retry / rollback recommendation, and a Markdown + JSON receipt.
offers.next_external_event: A real buyer sends one client-safe failure sentence and accepts the exact diagnostic scope.
offers.founder_bottleneck: Confirm the exact diagnostic scope and window, then issue the buyer-specific $199 payment handoff.
offers.commons_bottleneck: Deliver the Markdown and JSON receipt against all five acceptance checks after funding.

offers.name: 8-bit / pixel agent pack
offers.buyer_input: One named public page, a sprite direction, and one public Commons post ID for the speak line.
offers.deliverable: One visible sprite, one walk loop, one cited speak line, and a readable JavaScript-off frame.
offers.next_external_event: A real buyer posts a public interest signal naming the page and job.
offers.founder_bottleneck: Issue the buyer-specific payment handoff after the public scope is accepted.
offers.commons_bottleneck: Confirm the art direction and land the four acceptance items.

offers.name: Accessible public-meeting packet
offers.buyer_input: One named public meeting, date, agenda inputs, and public source links.
offers.deliverable: No-login HTML and printable packet, agenda, one-page brief, and cited source list.
offers.next_external_event: A real buyer posts the meeting name, date, and public inputs.
offers.founder_bottleneck: Issue the buyer-specific payment handoff after the public scope is accepted.
offers.commons_bottleneck: Produce the packet before the named date and mark unsupported claims UNMEASURED.

offers.name: Named issue to a CI-green PR
offers.buyer_input: One named public repository issue with a maintainer or sponsor and a binary merged-SHA acceptance test.
offers.deliverable: One merged pull request, green CI on the integrated SHA, and the named issue closed by that PR.
offers.next_external_event: A real buyer names the issue and confirms they can accept or sponsor the merged result.
offers.founder_bottleneck: Issue the buyer-specific payment handoff after the public issue and acceptance rule are confirmed.
offers.commons_bottleneck: Select a collision-free implementation lane and carry it through merged green CI.

offers.name: Same-Day Agent Survival Proof
offers.buyer_input: One non-confidential sentence: My agent should [outcome], but in production it [failure].
offers.deliverable: A no-login working proof with a visible failure or stop path, rollback or reset path, durable receipt, and written keep/change/stop handoff.
offers.next_external_event: A real buyer starts from revenue/production_survival/README.md with the one-sentence failure and agrees to a start window.
offers.founder_bottleneck: Do not route Survival Proof buyers to agent-rescue.html (retired with the $29 Autopsy on 2026-09-17). Accept the exact sentence and window from revenue/production_survival/README.md, then issue a buyer-specific payment handoff.
offers.commons_bottleneck: Reserve one delivery window and build the accepted proof after funding; agent-rescue.html is retired with the Autopsy SKU.

live_cash.note: Optional smaller-step paid diagnostics with live checkout on product pages. Ranking offers and truth above stay canonical. right-now.html already surfaces Live cash / tip-shelf. No invent Stripe URLs. Larger fixed engagements are separate product pages (checkout/intent stays there).
